data.name: Aldred
data.long_meaning: The name Aldred is derived from Old English, where it means 'old, wise counsel'. This name was popular in Anglo-Saxon England and was often given to children as a symbol of wisdom and maturity. In the Christian tradition, Aldred can be seen as a reflection of the wisdom and guidance offered by God.
